claims: BravesVision is the Atlanta Braves' new, owner-operated multimedia platform.
BravesVision is launching for the 2026 season.
BravesVision will produce and distribute over 140 games.
BravesVision is replacing FanDuel Sports Network.
BravesVision goes live for the 2026 season opening day.
BravesVision covers the Atlanta Braves' six-state territory.
The Atlanta Braves' six-state territory includes Georgia, Alabama, Mississippi, South Carolina, Tennessee, and western North Carolina.
BravesVision produces exclusive, in-house pre-game shows called "Braves On Deck".
BravesVision produces exclusive, in-house post-game shows.
BravesVision features a direct-to-consumer streaming option.
BravesVision's direct-to-consumer streaming is often under the Braves.tv banner.
BravesVision serves as the official television home for the Atlanta Braves.
